title: verify.rs check_message_digest: .iter().next() should be .first()
description: check_message_digest() uses md_attr.values.iter().next() to get the first attribute value. Idiomatic Rust uses .iter().next() only when you need the iterator for other things; the intent here is clearly 'get the first element', which is .first() (or .values.iter().next() which is the same, but .first() on a slice reads as intent).
close_reason: SetOfVec does not have .first(); .iter().next() is the correct idiom for this type
